definition: יַחְמוּר noun [masculine] roebuck (Samaritan יחמור , Syriac ᵑ7 יַחְמוּרָא see Hom NS 392 (and 339), Lag BN 127 ; name from reddish colour ?) — edible Deut 14:5 ; 1Kgs 5:3 — on identification with roebuck, see Tristr Proc. Zool. Soc. London, May 2, 1876 Conder Tent Work, 1887, p.91 .
